name: David Coher
office: Pasadena Area Community College District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 3

items.text: David Coher is a mediator and member of the Pasadena Rental Housing Board. He is board chair of the Arroyos & Foothills Conservancy. He has served on the Pasadena Planning Commission and Board of Zoning Appeals. His campaign calls for career pathways in cybersecurity, clean energy, and skilled trades, and using Pasadena City College for Eaton Fire recovery.
